Private DOCX/cover/PNG/PDF are not committed. Evidence: docs/reports/M7-word-qa.json, M7-deliverable-manifest.json and M7-final-validation.json.

Validation:24 public sources,3 historical M6 reports,14 frozen files,64 fixed application hashes,105 M4 archive files,4 M6 original DOCX hashes, formal public metrics, relative links, JSON/privacy and full diff whitespace passed. This role executed no product test, browser smoke, load or new diagram. Native b238 has only synthetic boundaries and limited P2 closure, no new full cycle. Preview20 requests is not20 independently recorded200 responses or full deployment.

Design checkpoint fa3b2fe1095aca78c02e80cad9de2ce187ff551b; MD checkpoint4d715d001fdeb19dd0d44db24bcf9eb25d0b361f; Word content/link refa462365cc8fd243bb9944121f1d34ee5373ea7b2; QA checkpoint6d9ca738ee29d9115bc862d03218c659f3e959c4. M6 historical126df is preserved on its branch. Stage06 bound applicationbc5; coordinator6ec receipt reports byte equivalence, not a new independent rerun.

Whitebox/deliverable outputs are not published to this role and were not read. Final acceptance is not passed: source6307 exceeds5100 by1207, formal failures remain, F08/capabilities unresolved, student final research and genuine12 edits/3 hallucination identifications/5 mappings lack completion evidence. No approval, success status or main merge.
